title: Work IQ: memory profile path in Work IQ MCP for agents
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, Copilot Credits billing and documented controls are supported. Two minor corrections remain: simplify the Graph call's presentation and cite the source for personal preferences. The new memory path's default and path-specific details remain undocumented in the material found.

claims.claim: Turning enhanced personalization off disables saved memories.
claims.quote: End-users that have the Enhanced personalization control turned off see the user-level controls for Custom instructions, Saved memories, and Chat history in Settings > Personalization as turned off. They can't turn on these settings.

claims.claim: Copilot Studio agent > Build > components panel > Memory toggle controls memory for agents using the Microsoft Copilot harness in preview.
claims.quote:
Create or open the agent in Copilot Studio.
Select the Build tab.
In the components panel, use the Memory toggle to turn the feature on or off.

claims.claim: No API equivalent of this Microsoft Copilot harness Memory toggle is documented.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Governance controls table and following paragraph
claims.claim: The maker turns memory on or off per Copilot Studio agent.
claims.quote: As the maker, you turn Memory on or off for each agent.

claims.claim: After 28 days without a user's interaction with that agent, their memories from that agent are deleted.
claims.quote: If a user doesn't interact with the agent for 28 days, the system deletes their memories from that agent.

claims.claim: Turning agent memory off does not delete stored memories.
claims.quote: Turning Memory off doesn't delete stored memories. It only prevents the agent from using them.

claims.claim: The tenant Work IQ MCP policy control is in Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > Tools > Work IQ MCP > Policy.
claims.quote:
In the left navigation, select Agents > Tools.
In the tools registry, select Work IQ MCP.
On the Work IQ MCP details pane, select the Policy tab when it's available.
Review the current policy state, then turn policy on or off for the tenant as needed.

claims.claim: No automation operation for the Work IQ MCP tenant policy switch is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "Work IQ" MCP policy settings API Graph update; "Work IQ" "policy" "PATCH". Read policy-governance-mcp and search excerpts for MCP overview/tool reference; no versioned policy-update endpoint or cmdlet found.

claims.claim: Retention policies do not apply to Copilot memory.
claims.quote: Retention policies and retention labels configured in Purview by organization admins don't apply to Copilot memory.

claims.claim: Administrators cannot restrict what information is remembered by Copilot memory.
claims.quote: No, admins can't restrict what type of information is added to Copilot memory.

claims.claim: Custom instructions are not discoverable through those administrator tools.
claims.quote: Custom instructions aren't accessible, but can manually be exported by the user through Settings > Personalization.

claims.claim: An administrator can delete memory data through Microsoft Graph Explorer in combination with Purview.
claims.quote: An admin can also delete memory data through Microsoft Graph Explorer in combination with Purview.
